held_out_status: exposed; the current exposed_test split is not a blind test for JEV
data_status: fixed Real-World v1 inputs; no cases, candidates, or grades changed

run.authentication: HTTP Bearer token from TYPESAFE_API_KEY; value not logged or stored
run.prompt_template: Determine whether the referenced candidate contains useful evidence needed to answer the task query. Return only its relevance score from 0 to 1. Candidate identifier: candidate_0.
run.score_primitive: one Noul relevance score per candidate, range 0..1

request_settings.temperature: not set by the Typesafe SDK System One request
request_settings.model_alias_note: jev-latest is an alias and may resolve to a changing model

usage.financial_cost_status: not reported by the System One response; no invoice/billing API queried

run.privacy: Only scores, ids, content hashes, timings, token counts, model ids, and error categories are saved; no API key or request/response body is stored.
limitations: All current relevance judgments are developer-authored; independent blind adjudication has not been performed.
The exposed_test split has been disclosed previously and is not a blind test for future JEV comparison.
Results are exploratory and do not establish scientific superiority or generalization.
The model alias may change; response model ids are recorded when available.
The API response reports token usage but not financial charge; actual USD cost is unavailable here.

paired_bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap of per-case JEV-minus-Lexical metric differences
paired_bootstrap.resampling_unit: case_id; each sampled unit preserves the JEV/Lexical pair
paired_bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive exploratory intervals on developer-authored judgments; not confirmatory evidence or a blind evaluation
